changes: Agents: mar-analyst and mar-reviewer pinned to claude-sonnet-5 with effort high, instead of the 'sonnet' alias and the client's default effort, so a campaign runs on the same model and effort whenever it is launched.
known_limits: gates.hull needs a Materials Project API key; without it the gate stays not_run (unchecked).
The ordered-sibling search needs a user-built local ICSD index (assets/icsd_query); no ICSD data ships.
hull.tol_eV_per_atom has no default, so gates.hull reports E_above_hull with pass: null until a threshold is configured.
The frozen-state check requires a git clone with the release tag; a source zip without .git cannot run the judgment layer.

changes: Gallery: mar-1.0 cards grouped by workflow-level certification, certification led on each card, failed-gate certified cards marked.

Episodes and defect ledger: provenance cleaned to what the source layer supports (secondary-sourced narrative removed, a held-out entry's description generalized, dangling defect pointers and artifact labels corrected); D20 restored from the pre-history backup; D40's label marked unresolved.
